one_liner: <ONE plain sentence: what the product does and for whom>

icp.q_keywords: <free-text terms describing the buyer's world, e.g. government contracting>

signal: <THE TRIGGER: a real, dated market event — a policy change, budget move, award, or mandate. 1-2 sentences. Keep it current and specific.>
offer: <ONE sentence: the concrete outcome the product delivers for this ICP>
_comment_cta: URL for the soft ask at the end of the email, and the page's link button. Use THIS PRODUCT'S OWN domain — do not inherit another product's contact page. OryonIQ shipped with visioneerit.com here by mistake and it read as bait-and-switch (fixed 2026-08-17). NOTE: this is a link, not an embed — see `booking_url` below before putting it anywhere near Sendr's calendar element.
_comment_booking_url: A URL that can be EMBEDDED — Sendr's calendar element puts its value in an <iframe src>. Deliberately SEPARATE from `cta`. Leave EMPTY unless you have a genuinely embeddable booking link (Calendly, HubSpot Meetings, Cal.com). An ordinary marketing or contact page will NOT work: they typically send `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN` and `frame-ancestors 'self'`, so the browser refuses to render them and the page shows a grey broken-content box. Verified on both company contact pages 2026-08-17. While this is empty, remove the calendar element from the Sendr template.
personalization_prompt: Write ONE specific opening line (max 2 sentences) for a cold email to {first_name}, {title} at {company}. Tie the signal to their reality. Do NOT invent facts about {company}. Keep the {first_name}, {title}, and {company} tokens exactly as written.
